_about: Rustamov (151159, golden_dragon_jr): the reborn Holy Dragon, a bratty kid now. Translated from the game's Japanese. Global names/terms: Rustamov, Armadeus/Rooma, Estariel (Estelle for short), Schult, Vagner, Lilith, Eleanor, Lothrend, Couette, Rams, Anbach, Light, Stella, Alk, the Silver Woods, Ancient Dragons, High Elves, Purgers. Own: Holy Dragon King (聖龍王), Dragon King (龍王), Gil Amdia, Drag Rudra, Itn Shuu (skill, as in units.json).
profile: The great Holy Dragon, who has lived the longest of the six Ancient Dragons. Wishing for the little princess's future, he was reborn after leaving his power behind for the sake of that love. And he turned out to have the biggest ego of anyone.
titleCondition: Level Rustamov to 100 and obtain his Amity Scroll

speech.home/fuuun_naniga: Hmmmmph. What's so great about Starview Village? Watch the stars all you want. Humans, the world, none of it has anything to do with me. ...What's with that face? I'm serious, okay!?
speech.home/himodoragontte: What's a "freeloader dragon"??? That's what I thought too, but come to think of it, it means having humans shower you with gifts, right? ...Kinda changes how I see it...
speech.home/haaa_anneechan: Haaah. Why is Sis Anbach such a nag? Sis Rams would never be like that-- No, wait, Sis Rams is scarier...
speech.home/fu_fufu_doda: ...Heh, heh heh...! How's that, I'm pretty great too, huh...? Estelle... Even you... ...Mmmm... Heh heh heh heh heh...
speech.home/oistella: Hey, Stella! Isn't your attitude toward Mr. Vagner a little lacking? Are you showing him proper re-spect? Then, fine...
speech.home/alk_aa: Alk...? Oh, the meal guy-- OWWW!? Wh-what was that for, Rooma!? ......Y-you don't have to get that mad...
speech.ally/join: I am the great Holy Dragon, Rustamov. ...Normally the likes of you would never get to speak with-- Ow!? Hey, ow! I said that hurts!! What is with that violent little runt of an elf!?
speech.ally/evolution: Good grief. Humans and elves are all way too high-minded. Ugh, fine, fine, I get it! I'll go along with you! ...Heh. You'd better be grateful.

1.title: Holy Dragon Reborn
1.summary: Attacked by Purgers right after his rebirth, Rustamov is saved by Estariel, leader of the elves. Rustamov keeps up his cheeky behavior, nothing like before his rebirth, and after getting carried away one too many times, he ends up under Estariel's "care".

lines.4: Ah... I see... So that's how it was. I'm--
lines.8: You're a dragon too, right? Running into each other mid-rebirth, what are the odds.
lines.12: Me? I'm Rustamov. The Holy Dragon! And you?
lines.21: A dragon who wants to be close to humans... huh. Hahaha.
lines.23: What a weirdo. I don't get it at all...!
lines.39: Princess of the elves. A rebirth.
lines.44: Rooma-- the Dragon of Darkness has appeared in Starview Village. According to him, the Holy Dragon Rustamov also--
lines.49: Enough. The forest has told me. I know every detail.
lines.52: I go now to see it through. You may come with me.
lines.66: Dammiiit!! What is with those guys~!!!
lines.91: L-let there be light! Itn Shuu!!
lines.102: Heh... You've gotten rather small, haven't you? Rustamov.
lines.113: Good! You're safe...! That was close, but--
lines.119: Small? You're the shrimp here! And who even are you!? Who do you think I am!?
lines.129: That's right, I am the greatest of dragons! The Holy Dragon, Rustamov! Shouldn't a mere human like you be bowing?
lines.137: Hmph. You really went and butted in. Small fry like that would've been no trouble at all for me, you know?
lines.146: ......H-how should I put it... He gives off a very different impression than before his rebirth...?
lines.161: He was a great one. Ever since I was young, he was strong, wise... and thoughtful...
lines.170: Are you picking a fight?? Hey, you're picking a fight, aren't you???
lines.173: And you're the wind dragon, right? Isn't a dragon who just learned to talk being a little cheeky??
lines.182: "Wind" is just there to make "light" look good, you know? Get it? Someone born to be a side character--
lines.198: Have a good, long taste of what wind is.
lines.208: Well, how about it? Show us your light. Go on and twinkle.
lines.218: L-let go of me, you violent runt!! Forehead! Shorty! I don't care about you--
lines.231: N-no no no! What is this town!? I'm never listening to anything you say, got it!?
lines.235: What a sore loser of a dragon...
lines.240: You're the one who dragged me here without asking!?
lines.248: A-ah... At first, she only meant to watch over him, you see?
lines.251: Seems she couldn't hold back after all.
lines.256: ...Estariel seems rather adorable today, doesn't she?
lines.266: I cannot bear to release him into the world like this. As thanks for his past life, I shall take "care" of him.
lines.275: I'm the great Holy Dragon! Rustamov himseeeelf!?

2.title: The Great Stubborn One
2.summary: Fed up with Estariel's tyranny and with being compared to his past self at every turn, Rustamov plots to secretly flee to another world. But Vagner's words fill him with admiration, and Rustamov resolves to make Estariel acknowledge him.

lines.6: This is the worst. The worst...!!
lines.14: What is with that violent little elf? I mean, really, really? Isn't she cheeky for a kid?
lines.18: B-but... then we'd be zero years old--
lines.22: No, age doesn't matter for dragons. You don't want someone acting big just because they got reborn a little earlier, right?
lines.26: ...Y-yeah... I don't want anyone acting big...?
lines.30: And by that logic, you're weird too, you know?
lines.38: ...I mean the whole thing about you being Rooma and becoming Armadeus.
lines.41: And how dragons work. I heard it from Sis Rams and the others. We're bait for the Champions, aren't we?
lines.44: In the Silver Woods, the elves keep telling me what the old me was like, even though I never asked.
lines.47: ...All of it. Every single thing. I hate it.
lines.55: As "Rooma", you could've said it had nothing to do with you, right? Why didn't you?
lines.62: Just like Couette did for me, I didn't want to let go either.
lines.69: You know, you're a weird guy.
lines.84: Heh heh. I got the authority from the Goddess. If I go to a world no one knows about, nobody can ever catch me--
lines.110: I see... It is about time, I suppose.
lines.118: You have made ties here. If anything happens, you would do well to rely on the people of this town.
lines.122: Go. Your wings are yours to command. Find the wind you love.
lines.130: I pray that a tomorrow awaits you wherever you go.
lines.139: Hmph...! Fine, if that's how it is! I'll do whatever I want!
lines.143: No, seriously, what is her deal!? Isn't that way too selfish? There should be more, other stuff, right!? Lots of stuff!
lines.152: If thou art leaving, then begone. Thou art an eyesore.
lines.162: Shut uuuup!? Who do you think you are!? Acting all high and mighty!?
lines.166: And what's with this "King Vagner" stuff anyway? King of who? Is that self-proclaimed? When you take orders from a human!
lines.170: You're lame! You! And the other dragons!! Every last one of you!!!
lines.174: I'm... not like that... What the old me was like has nothing to do with it...!
lines.179: Mr. Vagner and the Ancient Dragons are not lame.
lines.182: But you think so. Then what would make them not lame?
lines.191: ...Fate hath already loosed its hold upon us.
lines.195: Dragons will no longer die for the Champions.
lines.198: We decided not to let it happen.
lines.203: ......Then why? Why stay here and fight?
lines.217: And Mr. Vagner is a proud dragon.
lines.221: ......Hmph. I shall give the fools who sought to bind and define dragons a taste of my searing heat and sharp fangs.
lines.224: I shall show them. Is that not reason enough?
lines.243: So, yeah, that's how it is. Letting people look down on me would hurt a dragon's pride, you know?
lines.247: I've decided to show that violent little elf who the greatest Dragon King really is...!
lines.251: ......I get that already... But you... keep... keep talking about Estariel...?
lines.256: Obviously!? I mean, come on! When I said I'd stay after all, she went and--!?
lines.260: Well, anyway. I'm glad you stayed too.
lines.264: You know, you should stop saying stuff like that with a straight face.

3.title: Awakening of Light
3.summary: Rustamov has been bossing around Lothrend, a young elf who keeps looking after him without asking for anything in return. But in the battle against the Purgers, Lothrend shields him, and Rustamov loses heart at having failed to protect his friends. Encouraged by Estariel, he rises once more.

lines.5: ...Look. I'm pretty sure I've said this a bunch of times already.
lines.8: No matter how much you welcome me, you're not getting anything out of it, okay?
lines.14: I'm not the old Rustamov. I'm never going to sacrifice myself to put up a barrier or anything, okay?
lines.17: Yes! Of course! What matters most is that you take care of yourself!
lines.23: That won't do!! Then how about this? I have a friend with a fine coat of fur who's a funny guy. If I call him--
lines.27: No, no, it's fine! I'm not looking for funny stories! And besides--
lines.30: Why go so far when you get nothing back? Is something wrong with you?
lines.33: I understand that you are different from who you were before. Even so, when I am before you, my heart fills with gratitude.
lines.35: So this is simply me doing as I please. I'm only doing it to satisfy myself.
lines.38: Hmm. So it's self-satisfaction, then. In that case, I don't need to hold back.
lines.41: Get me something extra tasty. Like those baked sweets you guys like--
lines.47: Wh-what...! I said it's fine, so it's fine, okay!?
lines.71: Alright...! That takes care of this area...!
lines.77: It's the voices of an army... The allied forces of the Silver Woods are here...!
lines.80: ...Isn't there someone you're worried about, too?
lines.84: Don't be stupid. I'm only keeping you company--
lines.88: Got it. Then keep me company. It's over that way, right?
lines.94: --It's no good. We don't have the strength to break through. All we can do is wait to regroup.
lines.96: ...We alone could hold out. But do you think they can?
lines.98: Only the two of us will risk our lives. Any more than that, I can't promise--
lines.101: What are you two going on about?
lines.104: Lord Rustamov...! And Lord Armadeus too...
lines.107: Is this your self-satisfaction too? But they're strangers from a different world, aren't they?
lines.110: I want to return what I've been given.
lines.116: We elves are those who have been given. Walking for long, long ages with those we love, in a forest wrapped in peace, light, and song--
lines.118: And we elves never even knew that it was something merely given to us by chance.
lines.120: But now that I know the world, I cannot live the same way. I don't want to use my strength only to protect myself.
lines.122: If I have been given, then I want to use it to give.
lines.128: Whatever. It's a good way to kill time. I'll go along with it, Lothrend.
lines.134: Don't make fun of me. If I hear a name a few times, I remember--
lines.150: What's with elves... Are they a race of try-hards...?
lines.155: ......No... It's every one of them... Then... then--!
lines.163: You stupid puppeeeet!!! Keep your hands off my frieeeend!!
lines.206: Estelle... But I... I protected everyone--
lines.210: No. Not yet. It is not over yet...!
lines.214: Ugh... ah...? This is... could it be--?
lines.225: I had thought I could trust you to guard my back. Hmm, was I mistaken...?
lines.229: ...Oh, fine. If you're that scared, I'll help you out. Estelle!
lines.234: Ha, hahaha... You really are you, huh...
lines.240: I'll do it! I am the great Holy Dragon King...!

1151159/1.19:
The great Holy Dragon, who has lived the longest
of the six Ancient Dragons. Wishing for the little
princess's future, he was reborn after leaving his
power behind for the sake of that love. And he
turned out to have the biggest ego of anyone.

5000633/1.19:
A High Elf man who fusses over the reborn Rustamov at every turn.

Though he understands that Rustamov after his rebirth is a different being from before, he devotedly looks after him, hoping to return even a little of what he was given.

5000634/1.19:
One who stands at the pinnacle of dragons.
A great dragon.

The term, which probably carries such a meaning, was known as what Vagner calls himself, but at some point Rustamov started using it too, and somehow there are now two Dragon Kings.
